name: Beas de Segura (Spain)
description: A hoist stripe of one sixth chequy of green and white, the fly divided horizontally, red above and below barry of white and blue.
history: The flag of Beas de Segura is rectangular with a proportion between the width and the length of 2 to 3, parted vertically at 1/6 from the hoist and chequy in three columns; the arms bear the motto MUY NOBLE E MUY LEAL VILLA DE VEAS and were published in the BOJA on 21 September 2009.

features.role: chequy hoist stripe of one sixth in three columns
upper half of the fly red
lower half of the fly barry of white and blue
